title: Send a batch within your rate limit
summary: Start one SMS request per documented interval for the number type while leaving carrier delivery timing to the platform.
scenario: A bike shop texting two hundred customers that the spring service special is on, from one 10DLC number

evidence: https://signalwire.com/docs/platform/rate-limits (fetched 2026-09-02): 10DLC 4 MPS, toll-free 3 MPS, short code 10 MPS, 10,000 queued messages, then the queue stops accepting
